control_families.eeo_checkbox_multi: input[type=checkbox] name=bfe-<x>-<n> one per option (race/ethnicity multi-select)
control_families.consent_checkbox: input[type=checkbox]#initialConsent 'By checking this box, I consent to the use of my personal data in accordance with the privacy policies outlined above.' (not DOM-required; likely enforced on Apply)
